description: This file defines a GStreamer metadata structure for protection data used in media processing, including class and method declarations related to protection metadata handling.

classes.name: GstRialtoProtectionData
classes.description: Structure holding protection metadata such as session ID, buffers, cipher mode, and decryption service pointer.

classes.name: GstRialtoProtectionMetadata
classes.description: Structure combining GstMeta parent with protection data, used as a custom metadata type in GStreamer.

methods.name: rialto_eme_protection_metadata_get_type
methods.description: Function to get the GType for GstRialtoProtectionMetadata, used in GObject type system.

methods.name: rialto_mse_protection_metadata_get_info
methods.description: Function to get metadata info for GstRialtoProtectionMetadata.
